name: mirage-engine
description: A code-only world engine for AI agents: build whole towns and landscapes in three.js, in parallel, as code.

scripts.test: npm test -ws --if-present && node agent/check.mjs && npm run test:static && npm run test:checks
scripts.test:static: eslint . && node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-types.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.test:still-pop: node packages/tools/src/still-pop.mjs examples/hello-courtyard/dist examples/walled-garden/dist examples/garden-quest/dist examples/agent-trial/dist
scripts.test:touch: node packages/tools/src/touch-check.mjs examples/hello-courtyard/dist examples/walled-garden/dist examples/garden-quest/dist examples/agent-trial/dist examples/snow-hut/dist
scripts.test:gpu-load: node packages/tools/src/gpu-load.mjs examples/hello-courtyard/dist examples/walled-garden/dist examples/garden-quest/dist examples/agent-trial/dist examples/snow-hut/dist
